newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CompDent started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CompDent started as buy.

text.p: Piper Jafray said it initiated coverage of CompDent Corp with a buy rating and a price target of $25 to $27 per share.
-- Analyst John Penshorn said his 1997 earnings estimate for CompDent was $1.15 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate was $1.40 per share.

-- "CompDent is one of the leading managed dental care companies in the industry, offering investors a pure play on managed dental benefits with a dental practice management kicker," he said in a research note.
-- Penshorn said he expected same-store sales growth to start to improve in the third and fourth quarters.
